items.stem: A Product Owner prioritises the backlog by whichever stakeholder emails most often. A more value-driven approach is to prioritise by:

options.text: Expected value and effort relative to the product goal
options.rationale: Correct: value-and-effort prioritisation serves the product goal, not email volume.
Email volume does not reflect value.
Writing order is not a value signal.

items.explanation: Correct: value-and-effort prioritisation serves the product goal, not email volume.

items.stem: A well-formed user story's acceptance criteria primarily serve to:

options.text: Define what 'done' means for that story so it can be verified
options.rationale: Correct: acceptance criteria make a story testable and clear.
Not the purpose of acceptance criteria.
Criteria do not replace the vision.

options.text: Maximising the value of the product

options.text: Maintaining a clear, prioritised Product Backlog
options.rationale: Correct: the PO keeps the backlog ordered and transparent.
